description: Get a short-lived link where the user uploads product pictures from their phone or computer — use it when the user has pictures you cannot read (you do not get the bytes of attachments). Give the user the url; when they say they are done, call getUploadSession with the token to get the upload ids, then setProductImages. JPG/PNG/WebP only, up to maxFiles pictures (default 10, max 20), valid for 60 minutes. The link only adds pictures to the media library — it attaches nothing and shows no rikma data. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#createUploadSessionTool

maxFiles.description: How many pictures the link accepts. Default 10.

productId.description: The product the pictures are for (shown on the page; attaching is still setProductImages).

projectId.description: Rikma (project) id, from findUserProjectsTool. You must be a member.

name: createUploadSessionTool
